attorneys: Appellant pro se., Louis J. Lefkowitz, Attorney General of New York, Paxton Blair, Solicitor General, and JeanM. Coon, Assistant Attorney General, for Honorable Aron Steuer, Justice of the New York Supreme Court, appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
